welcome.title: Welcome to AgentSync
welcome.description: Keep your global AI agent configuration files (Claude, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode) continuously synchronized across your computers with git-backed version control.

preview.title: Sync Preview
preview.backups_notice: Safety backups will be automatically created before applying overwrites.

conflicts.title: Conflict Resolution
conflicts.subtitle: Choose which version to keep for each conflicting file:

initial_link.title: Initial Link Detected
initial_link.description: The destination directory already contains files that differ from the repository. Choose how you want to proceed:
initial_link.use_repo_desc: Overwrites local files with repository versions (safety backup created).
initial_link.use_local_desc: Overwrites repository files with local files on next sync.
initial_link.decide_later_desc: Keep both intact; mark connection as untracked difference.
